text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean and consistent. Although code reviews take time, they are a valuable investment. Teams that review code carefully usually produce better software and work together more effectively.
